responsibility: Declares the analyzer’s region_model subsystem and its surrounding support types. Beyond the main region_model API for symbolic memory, this header defines region-to-value maps, purge statistics, visitor hooks, region_model_context decorators, model-merger and rejected-constraint structures, the lightweight engine wrapper around region_model_manager, and selftest helpers and assertions used to exercise memory modeling and constraint reasoning.
same_name_distinction: Declares the region_model subsystem’s public types and interfaces—such as region_to_value_map, purge/visitor/context helpers, model_merger, rejected_constraint, and the engine wrapper—while region-model.cc provides the concrete execution semantics and selftest implementations behind those declarations.
